name: Anka India Limited
summary: Anka India Limited operates in a dual capacity, both providing software solutions and manufacturing shoe soles from polyurethane and thermoplastic rubber. The company produces soles, midsoles, and direct injection process (DIP) footwear components using specialized molds sourced from Italy and Germany. Its product range serves shoe manufacturers and exporters throughout India. Established on September 13, 1994, the firm's main offices are located in New Delhi, India.
